trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum is automatic: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt down. Work the roadmap stages in order and let this one arrive on its own — when the tracker reads 54 of 54 others earned, Vice Got a Price! is yours.
steps: The Platinum pops on its own

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 1 — but do not rush the chapter's end. One meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude sits on Lucia's balcony during Chapter 1 and disappears afterwards, and the game has no mission replay. Meditate there first, then finish the chapter, and drop a manual save at the chapter break.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold trophy for reaching 100% on the game's completion checklist. This is the long tail of the Platinum: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and world tasks all feed the percentage. Current guides report that nothing on the 100% checklist is missable, so treat it as a clean-up trophy and work the in-game checklist one category at a time.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts register as you launch vehicles off ramps and stunt points, so weave them into ordinary driving instead of grinding them in one sitting. PSN tracks the count for you — the counter here mirrors it — and a failed attempt is best retried on the spot while the route is fresh.
